summary: Iteration 50 — tested Payment Rules API+UI, Pre-flight Checklist API+UI, Auction Push Alerts (code review). 16/18 backend pytest assertions pass. Payment Rules panel, dialog and all rule fields render correctly with data-testids. Pre-flight dialog renders 12 passenger items with categories, progress bar, aircraft readiness card. TWO KEY ISSUES: (1) SECURITY: GET /api/preflight/checklist/{booking_id} has NO auth guard — returns 200 for unauthenticated requests and cross-customer requests; (2) UX: Admin dashboard sidebar (aside) is display:none on desktop viewport (1920px) so users cannot navigate to the Payment Rules Panel via the sidebar (had to JS-click). Payment rules reset to default 50% empty rules (live flows safe). Auction alert code (quotesCountRef null-guard, WebAudio, toast, Notification) reviewed and correct.

critical.issue: Missing auth dependency. No get_current_user Depends → endpoint accepts unauthenticated requests (returns 200) and lets ANY logged-in customer read another customer's checklist (should be 401/403). Requirement explicitly states this must require auth and 403 for cross-customer access. Add `current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)` and call `_check_read_access(booking, current_user)` similar to /preflight/status/{booking_id}.

ui_bugs.issue: On desktop (1920x1080), <aside> computed style is `display: none` (matched by `.hidden` CSS rule) even though isCollapsed=false and width/height are 288x1007. Result: entire admin sidebar is invisible on load — user cannot click on 'Finance & Billing' → 'Payment Rules' nav item. Panel itself works when navigated programmatically. Likely cause: the multi-line className with embedded /* comments */ may be introducing a `hidden` class token or Tailwind class ordering conflict. Repro: login as admin → /admin → sidebar not visible. `document.querySelector('aside')` shows display:none via `.hidden`.

action_items: Add auth guard to GET /api/preflight/checklist/{booking_id}: add `current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)` and `_check_read_access(booking, current_user)` after fetching booking. Same as /preflight/status/{booking_id}.

Fix admin sidebar visibility on desktop — aside is being hidden by `.hidden` CSS on load. Investigate the multi-line className in /app/frontend/src/components/shared/Sidebar.js (lines 110-129); consider replacing the inline block comments and template literal with a `clsx`/`cn` helper, or verify Tailwind isn't purging w-72/lg:sticky classes. Reproduces at width 1920. Without the sidebar, users cannot reach the new Payment Rules nav item.
Consider matching customer route path: /my-trips returns 0 preflight buttons; /customer/trips works. Verify canonical URL and update any docs/redirects.
critical_code_review_comments: preflight_routes.py get_checklist(): booking lookup happens but no user check. Anyone knowing a booking_id can read the checklist state. Add `current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)` + `_check_read_access(booking, current_user)`.

components/shared/Sidebar.js: inline /* Tailwind comments */ inside className string are anti-pattern — safer to use `clsx()` and remove multiline block-comments from the class list. Currently the aside is getting `display:none` at desktop.

payment_rules_routes.py resolve_payment_rule looks solid (case-insensitive substring, priority sort, amount range checks all correct). Verified via preview API: Mumbai→Pune 600k→100%, medical 100k→25%, low-value Mumbai→Pune→75% fallback rule.

success_rate.backend: 89% (16/18 pytest assertions, 2 failures are the auth-guard security bug on GET /preflight/checklist)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (Payment Rules Panel + Preflight dialog fully functional; sidebar visibility bug blocks nav)

rca_of_the_issue: 1) GET /preflight/checklist/{booking_id} was likely written before the auth guards were added — the sibling endpoints /preflight/status/{booking_id}, /preflight/checklist/update, /preflight/checklist/submit all use `current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)`, but this GET was missed. 2) Admin sidebar display:none: className string in Sidebar.js concatenates template literal with block-comments AND `overflow-x-hidden`. Some token in the merged string is matching `.hidden` (Tailwind display:none !important). Recommended fix: use clsx()/cn() helper instead of multiline template literals with comments.
